title: Vacuum energy secrecy to prevent weaponization

tellings.quote:
what if the
government discovered that it's not that
hard after all
to to access the physical vacuum and
extract energy from it.

plain: A researcher named Kurt McConnell suggests on the show that the US government may have found it is "not that hard after all" to draw energy out of the physical vacuum, the empty space that physics says still holds energy, and kept that secret so it could not be turned into a weapon. He offers it as a "what if", without naming a source, and points to the inventor Nikola Tesla and to an American inventor named T. T. Brown. If true, it would mean a near limitless power source has been hidden on purpose.
